acceptance_criteria: Roster loading, initial failure, valid empty, nonempty, stale retained, and recovered states render distinctly.
Detail or configuration failure cannot render no-tool, runtime-default, no-plugin, or no-vector-store conclusions.
A successful configuration read that proves those fields absent retains the existing honest empty states.
Provider loading, unavailable, unconfigured, configured, stale retained, and recovered states render distinctly.
Retry actions target only their failed query while healthy sibling data and the selected agent remain visible.
Provider mutations disclose an unavailable or stale before-state and require a fresh post-write read before success is claimed.
Live-session availability reuses #2527 rather than creating a second state model.
Accessible copy preserves source, availability, freshness, and last-success age without exposing raw errors.
Mutation tests fail if operational query results are projected through default empty arrays, undefined configuration, or em-dash-only provider values.
blast_radius: The Agents roster, selected-agent configuration and brain panels, provider mutation before-state, stale-data interpretation, recovery proof, and any operator decision based on apparent configuration absence.
evidence_summary: All decisive source and focused-test blobs are byte-identical between the prior pin and 9a1bd7b3d3c529b276c1ad764d2c312d7f3abfc3. Exact-main Agents source destructures only data from roster, selected-line, and provider-status queries. Roster failure therefore uses an empty array, while failed detail and provider reads become undefined. The page and panels project those fallbacks as no agents, no tool knobs, runtime defaults, no plugins, no vector store, provider placeholder, and em-dash values. The sibling provider card preserves loading, error, and retry, and useLines already exposes freshness, proving the fail-visible primitives exist. Nineteen write-free source assertions reproduced the loss. The Agents and provider-card suites passed 54 of 54 tests again at the new exact main but do not distinguish query failure or retained-after-error data from successful empty state. One historical complete nested capture covered 237 open issues, all 39 open pull requests, all changed-file and closing-reference pages, and 37 labels. A required second capture failed closed because the top-level inventory changed, so no stable complete-estate claim is made. The historical capture and direct searches found no implementation owner; publication still requires the declared fresh estate rescan.
falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The issue is falsified if the pinned Agents page preserves independent availability, freshness, retained-data, retry, and recovery state for roster, detail, and provider queries before rendering domain-empty copy. Exact source assertions show it does not. The three audit-only jsdom failure tests described in the issue were removed and cannot be rerun from the current tree; the green control suites prove current behavior, not the missing failure contract.
impact: An unavailable fleet or configuration source can look successfully empty or unconfigured, causing false diagnosis and provider changes without a trustworthy before-state.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read issue #2532 immediately before publication and reject the record if its state, node identity, title, labels, update time, or exact body hash changed.
Reconfirm SSH origin, tracking main, remote main, and API main agreement before integration.
Repeat two complete nested estate captures and require exact equality before relying on PR ownership or overlap completeness.
Coordinate roster observation with #2531, live-session state with #2527, canonical vocabulary with #2447, safe error projection with #2517, and presentation with #2523.
Add executable initial-failure, retained-after-error, scoped-retry, stale-before-write, post-write-reread, and recovery tests before completion.
Keep automatic provider recovery and unrelated configuration mutation outside this visibility change.
